answer: The KPI includes regular and temporary Nestle employees, non-employees, contractors and visitors working at Nestle-managed sites, plus incidents involving Nestle employees at non-Nestle-managed sites such as travel, sales activities and distribution centers. Stand-alone businesses are excluded except Nespresso and Nestle Health Science. The numerator includes fatalities, irreversible cases, lost-time cases, restricted-work cases and medical-treatment-beyond-first-aid cases.
subject: Nestle S.A.
scope_boundary: recordable injury rate per million hours worked

evidence.quote: The KPI covers Nestle-managed sites where all employees ... non-employees and contractors (including third-party workers ... and visitors) ... non-Nestle-managed sites that involve a Nestle employee ... does not include stand-alone businesses except for Nespresso and Nestle Health Science ... fatalities, irreversible cases, lost time cases, restricted work cases, and medical treatment cases beyond first aid
